summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi China 2x Daily ETF (CCPX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the iShares China Large-Cap ETF (NYSE Arca: FXI), which tracks a market-cap-weighted index of the 50 largest Chinese stocks traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. CCPX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
